Native R functional transformations and scientific diagnostics

etr_native_functional_diagnostics.Rd

Twelve Python-free implementations of selected eyetrajectoriespy 1.2.0 functional transformations, distance summaries and phase diagnostics. Native R implementations have been authored; comprehensive one-to-one Python contract equivalence has not been established.

Usage

etr_alr_transform(values, reference_dimension = -1L, epsilon = 1e-8,
  python_boundary_mode = FALSE)
etr_inverse_alr(transformed, reference_dimension, n_dimensions,
  python_boundary_mode = FALSE)
etr_component_trajectories(result, component, sd_multipliers = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2))
etr_select_n_components(result, threshold = 0.95)
etr_fpca_score_frame(result, prefix = "FPC")
etr_score_distance_matrix(fpca, n_components = NULL,
  python_boundary_mode = FALSE)
etr_pairwise_functional_distances(trajectories, dimension_weights = NULL)
etr_sparse_dimension_summary(trajectories, dimension)
etr_warping_displacement(result)
etr_phase_summary(result)
etr_phase_trajectory_set(registration, representation = "displacement")
etr_fit_phase_fpca(registration, representation = "displacement",
                   n_components = 0.95)

Arguments

values

Three-dimensional numeric array of compositional probabilities. In explicit Python boundary mode, a complex atomic 3D ndarray-style input is cast to its real component as NumPy's dtype=float conversion does. Regular mixed-type Python-style nested scalar lists, including Boolean leaves, use elementwise rather than whole-container R coercion.

reference_dimension

Python-style zero-based reference component; -1 selects the last. In Python boundary mode a Boolean reference index is converted to 0 or 1, matching Python integer-index behavior.

epsilon

Strictly positive clipping floor for ALR, declared before analysis.

python_boundary_mode

Logical, opt-in Python 1.2 boundary validation where implemented; the default FALSE retains the native R input domain. For ALR and inverse ALR, preserves 3D output shape when the curve or time axis is empty, matching frozen Python 1.2 source semantics. It also accepts complex ndarray-style 3D input after discarding imaginary coordinates and Boolean reference indices. In inverse ALR it requires an integer storage-type dimension count as NumPy does when constructing an output shape; nonfinite source exponentiation is propagated rather than rejected. For score-distance matrices, sparse Matrix inputs use native sparse row norms and Gram products, with a dense output of no more than five million cells. In explicit Python boundary mode, minimal duck-typed FPCA score objects may declare more components than their score matrix actually contains: a requested integer slice uses the available columns, matching NumPy; a fractional declared count requires an explicit integer slice count. In score-distance source mode, dense and sparse matrices use scikit-learn-style squared norms and Gram products and can return Inf or NaN from numerical overflow, or lose tiny distances through cancellation. Strict native R mode retains the more stable stats::dist computation. Strict default native FPCA-object validation is preserved. This flag does not invoke Python or certify full-domain equivalence.

transformed

Finite three-dimensional ALR values in the strict default mode. In Python boundary mode, complex ndarray values are cast to real and NaN/Inf logarithms use source arithmetic.

n_dimensions

Original number of channels, at least one. The NumPy source-mode shape contract accepts integer scalars, not Boolean or floating-point scalars, even if numerically integral.

result

A native FPCA fit or registration result, as appropriate.

component

Zero-based index of a fitted FPCA component.

sd_multipliers

Finite standard deviation multipliers for component curves.

threshold

Cumulative explained variance threshold in (0, 1].

prefix

Component score column prefix.

fpca

Native fitted FPCA object, or a minimal validated score-bearing list. With python_boundary_mode=TRUE, accepts Matrix-package sparse score matrices without densification of the input; Matrix remains optional for ordinary native use.

n_components

Number of retained FPCA components or requested variance fraction, as appropriate.

trajectories

Native complete common-grid or irregular trajectory set, depending on the diagnostic.

dimension_weights

Optional nonnegative spatial-channel weights.

dimension

Name of one irregularly sampled dimension.

registration

Native registration with original trajectories and reference-to-source warpings.

representation

Either "displacement" or "warping".

Value

A matrix, array, data frame, list, native trajectory set, or native FPCA fit according to the selected function. All paths are Python-free.

Details

The ALR clipping threshold, target component count, registration orientation and finite-observation support must be specified and recorded. Python result dataclass identity and generalized inference are not claimed.
